design.window: Non-phasing O at start of P player turn, Game Turns 2-8, with a following recorded row. The final player turn is excluded.
design.outcomes: Recorded O objective/step losses during P turn (stepsLost all step-loss events, split into attritionStepsLost and combatStepsLost); positive rise in O outOfTrace or decline in HQ count to the following row; P objectives and objective VP gained in its turn; attritionNextTurn is O attrition in the following row when that row is O turn, else missing.
design.models: Zero event; training median; training mean; intercept plus distance baseline; intercept plus baseline plus metric; training conditional medians in baseline or metric buckets, fixed at 0, 1, 2-3, 4-7, 8+ from the historical descriptive analysis, and in training quintile bins (for ratios, columns and expected losses). Baseline and intercept unpenalized; standardized added metric fixed ridge penalty 1. Unseen bucket falls back to training median. No hyperparameter search. Complete cases shared across models; train-only preprocessing.
design.mover: Features prefixed mover. are the phasing player P metrics at the same row; the others are O metrics.
design.primarySplit: Ten folds of map seed, sorted by SHA256 and assigned round-robin. All styles, roles, policy variants and aliases of a seed stay together.
design.sensitivitySplit: Each source parent directory is one held-out batch. Training excludes every trajectory with any alias in that batch and every map seed appearing in its test data. Batches are reported separately because test trajectories can have multiple aliases.
design.batchMeaning: Provenance source parent directory, not independently verified policy version. Policy strings and variants are aliases retained verbatim.
design.intervals: 1000 paired seed-cluster draws on fixed out-of-fold errors. Conditional, exploratory intervals without multiplicity correction.

passRule: Written before the results (docs/roadmap/18-position-metrics-wbs.md section 1 and P4): in a role subset, the metric bucket model beats zero, training median and the baseline bucket model on MAE with every 95% interval above 0, or baseline-plus-metric beats the baseline on out-of-sample R2 with the interval above 0.
